mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, e.batch_id AS batchId, COALESCE(bb.batch_name, bb.batch_no) AS batchName, e.export_format AS format, e.status, COALESCE( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.param_json, '$.assetCount')), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_asset a JOIN label_data_entry en ON en.id = a.entry_id AND en.deleted = 0 WHERE a.project_id = e.project_id AND a.deleted = 0 AND (a.frame_flag IS NULL OR a.frame_flag <> 'invalid') AND (e.batch_id IS NULL OR en.batch_id = e.batch_id) AND en.label_status IN ('labeled', 'revised') AND en.review_status = 'passed') ) AS assetCount, e.result_url AS resultUrl, e.error_message AS errorMessage, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, '未知') AS createdBy, e.create_time AS createTime FROM label_export_job e JOIN label_project p ON p.id = e.project_id LEFT JOIN label_asset_batch bb ON bb.id = e.batch_id AND bb.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = e.created_by WHERE e.deleted = 0 ORDER BY e.id DESC

SELECT e.id, e.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, e.batch_id AS batchId, COALESCE(bb.batch_name, bb.batch_no) AS batchName, e.export_format AS format, e.status, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.param_json, '$.assetCount')), 0) AS assetCount, e.result_url AS resultUrl, e.error_message AS errorMessage, e.param_json AS paramJson, e.create_time AS createTime FROM label_export_job e JOIN label_project p ON p.id = e.project_id LEFT JOIN label_asset_batch bb ON bb.id = e.batch_id AND bb.deleted = 0 WHERE e.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_project WHERE id = #{projectId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_asset_batch WHERE id = #{batchId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(batch_name, batch_no) FROM label_asset_batch WHERE id = #{batchId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_data_entry WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND deleted = 0 AND NOT (label_status IN ('labeled', 'revised') AND review_status = 'passed')

SELECT b.id, b.batch_no AS batchNo, COALESCE(b.batch_name, b.batch_no) AS batchName, COUNT(en.id) AS entryCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_asset a JOIN label_data_entry q ON q.id = a.entry_id AND q.deleted = 0 WHERE a.batch_id = b.id AND a.deleted = 0 AND (a.frame_flag IS NULL OR a.frame_flag <> 'invalid') AND q.label_status IN ('labeled', 'revised') AND q.review_status = 'passed') AS assetCount FROM label_asset_batch b JOIN label_data_entry en ON en.batch_id = b.id AND en.deleted = 0 WHERE b.project_id = #{projectId} AND b.deleted = 0 GROUP BY b.id, b.batch_no, b.batch_name HAVING COUNT(en.id) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN en.label_status IN ('labeled', 'revised') AND en.review_status = 'passed' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 0 ORDER BY b.id DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE label_export_job SET status = 'success', result_url = #{resultUrl}, error_message = NULL, param_json = JSON_SET(IFNULL(param_json, JSON_OBJECT()), '$.assetCount', #{assetCount}), updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'processing'
UPDATE label_export_job SET status = 'failed', error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'processing'
UPDATE label_export_job SET status = 'canceled', updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 'success'
mapper.select:
SELECT asset.id AS assetId, asset.media_type AS mediaType, asset.file_name AS fileName, asset.file_url AS fileUrl, asset.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, asset.file_size AS fileSize, asset.width AS width, asset.height AS height, asset.upload_id AS uploadId, asset.frame_flag AS frameFlag, asset.invalid_reason AS invalidReason, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(asset.meta_json, '$')) AS metaJson FROM label_asset asset JOIN label_data_entry en ON en.id = asset.entry_id AND en.deleted = 0 WHERE asset.project_id = #{projectId} AND asset.deleted = 0
AND (asset.frame_flag IS NULL OR asset.frame_flag <> 'invalid') AND en.batch_id IN #{bid} AND ORDER BY asset.id

SELECT j.id AS jobId, j.job_no AS jobNo, j.data_type AS mediaType, asset.id AS assetId, asset.file_name AS fileName, a.id AS annotationId, a.version, a.status AS annotationStatus, ao.object_key AS objectKey, ao.object_type AS objectType, ao.class_id AS classId, c.label_name AS className, c.color, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$')) AS geometryJson, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.attr_json, '$')) AS attrJson FROM label_annotation a JOIN label_job j ON j.id = a.job_id AND j.deleted = 0 JOIN label_asset asset ON asset.id = a.asset_id AND asset.deleted = 0 JOIN label_data_entry en ON en.id = asset.entry_id AND en.deleted = 0 JOIN label_annotation_object ao ON ao.annotation_id = a.id AND ao.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN label_class c ON c.id = ao.class_id WHERE asset.project_id = #{projectId} AND a.deleted = 0
AND (asset.frame_flag IS NULL OR asset.frame_flag <> 'invalid') AND en.batch_id IN #{bid} AND ORDER BY asset.id, j.id, ao.id

SELECT dr.id, p.project_name AS projectName, dr.export_job_id AS exportJobId, dr.dataset_version AS datasetVersion, dr.export_format AS format, dr.asset_count AS assetCount, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, '未知') AS deliveredBy, dr.delivered_time AS deliveredTime FROM label_delivery_record dr JOIN label_project p ON p.id = dr.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = dr.delivered_by WHERE dr.deleted = 0 ORDER BY dr.id DESC
